fact: Buppido repeatedly invokes “the divine plan” without identifying the divinity.
source_quote: Buppido repeatedly invoked “the divine plan” without identifying the divinity behind it.
subject: Buppido

fact: Thorin and Gyrgum conclude that Buppido might believe he is a god.

subject: Thorin and Gyrgum's deduction

fact: Thorin observes Buppido's behavior alongside Gyrgum.
source_quote: Thorin and Gyrgum gradually concluded
subject: Thorin

fact: Buppido proposes that the other prisoners distract the enemy while he escapes through the waterfall.
source_quote: “It's quite simple. All of you will distract the enemy while I escape through the waterfall.”
subject: Buppido's escape plan

fact: Buppido admits he needs to consider the divine plan more carefully when asked about the others' escape.
source_quote: he admitted that he needed to consider the divine plan more carefully.
subject: Buppido

fact: Thorin flatters Buppido by suggesting the divine plan arranged for the prisoners to escape and protect him.
source_quote: Thorin pointed out that Buppido would be entering the Underdark without protection, and flattered him with the idea that the divine plan must have arranged for everyone to escape so they could protect him.
subject: Thorin's flattery

fact: Buppido eagerly accepts Thorin's logic about needing protection.
source_quote: Buppido eagerly accepted the logic.
subject: Buppido

fact: Buppido grants the prisoners insight into the divine plan's mysteries later that evening in exchange for their pledges.
source_quote: he declared, “since you have pledged your swords … your spells … your lives, at least, to protecting the divine plan, I will grant you insight into its mysteries later this evening.”
subject: Buppido's pledge requirement

fact: Buppido promises to reveal insights into the divine plan's mysteries later this evening.
source_quote: I will grant you insight into its mysteries later this evening
subject: divine plan mysteries
